LanguageData.TMM.Complex.ServicesHelp: Choose the whole complex and optional staff-only rooms. Guests cannot enter the staff area; staff may move and work elsewhere. Beds outside staff rooms become guest beds, except explicitly assigned staff housing. Mark any bed medical to make the entire enclosed room a ward. Bedroom tables serve only that room’s guests; restaurant service excludes wards. Waiters prefer suitable meals in complex fridges, then accessible colony fridges. A restaurant service counter is required.
LanguageData.TMM.Complex.MedicalHelp: The medical setting applies to the whole enclosed room within the complex. No separate clinic area or Hospital bed flags are required. Staff-only and colony wards outside guest access remain for the colony.
